cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Put It Back Quietly
cards.instruction: Return something you misplaced, used, or damaged without revealing why it needed restoring.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've got your work things ready. Umbrella back in its stand; I'll manage the drying while you have breakfast.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Why does it need drying? It hasn't rained.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Routine rinse. You like a clean handle, don't you? I'll use whichever towel you prefer.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I prefer an umbrella without pondweed in the spokes.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally, a full clean. I'll do each spoke before you leave. Keep your usual breakfast time; I'm making this fit your morning.

heightening.evidence: A5 treats stronger evidence of a hidden incident as an expanded cleaning specification.
